subject: Finova – Renewal & expansion call recap (usage review & next steps)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@finova.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finova – Renewal & expansion call recap (usage review & next steps)

Alex / team — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side (call notes + proposed next steps):

Summary of pain points you flagged:
- Significant latency spikes during peak batch scoring windows (even though average is fine).
- Rising token spend tied to nightly embedding/rerank jobs and unbatched online reranking.
- Need for predictable throughput and isolation for customer-facing inference (SLO requirement).

Goals we heard:
- P50/P95 latency under 120ms/350ms for mission-critical routes.
- Reduce unit cost ~20% vs current hosted setup by Q3 through dedicated capacity + caching.
- Enable two new workloads in 2027: nightly embedding pipeline (search) + live reranking for recommendations.

What Redwood proposes (high level):
- Pilot Dedicated capacity (2x reserved GPU nodes) to validate steady-state throughput + tail latency.
- Apply prefix caching + batching + quantization profiles from Redwood Optimize to reduce token spend.
- Run a 6-week pilot: baseline week (current), 4-week pilot, 1-week evaluation.

Action items / owners:
- Alex (Finova): confirm pilot scope & provide anonymized sample traffic for embedding job (by 2027-03-08).
- Monica (Redwood CS): deliver pilot config and initial cost/latency estimate (by 2027-03-04).
- Rishi (Redwood AE): coordinate procurement path and commercial terms; share T&Cs and DocuSign link (by 2027-03-10).

Attachments: usage_report_q1.xlsx (summary of your current consumption that you shared in the call).

Open questions we flagged:
- Data residency: you mentioned EU plans in H2 — do we need EU capacity for this pilot or can that be staged later?
- Quantization: are you comfortable running quantized variants for the embedding/rerank models in pilot?

If that aligns, I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next week to walk through the pilot runbook and success metrics.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Subject: Re: Finova – Renewal & expansion call recap (usage review & next steps)

Alex — thanks for the quick reply. A few technical clarifications and a proposed pilot blueprint below.

Current usage summary (from your exported report):
- Avg daily tokens (generation + embedding): ~1.2B tokens/day.
- Nightly embedding batch: ~350M tokens across a 2-hour window.
- Live rerank route: ~25 requests/s at 512 tokens average.

Pilot proposal (6 weeks):
- Environment: Dedicated pool (2x A10-like GPUs) with autoscale headroom for bursts.
- Config: batching for nightly jobs (batch size 1024), prefix/KV caching for live rerank, and mixed-precision quantization for embedded model.
- Success metrics: p50 < 120ms / p95 < 350ms on live rerank; 20% reduction in $/1k tokens for the embedded pipeline vs your current hosted plan.
- Observability: we’ll provision a shared dashboard (latency, tokens, cost-per-route) + weekly sync.

Pre-work we need from Finova:
1) Anonymized sample traffic for embedding job (CSV + small payload set) — target 2027-03-07.
2) A list of critical routes that must remain on hosted endpoints during pilot (if any).

I’ve attached a draft T&Cs that covers the pilot scope and data handling notes. Also included is an estimated cost range for the 6-week run.

Appreciate if procurement can confirm target PO date so we can align resource reservations.

— Monica
Customer Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
